items.title: Microsoft Releases KB5089573 for Windows 11 to Fix Patch Tuesday Install Issues
items.description: Microsoft has rolled out a new cumulative update, KB5089573, for Windows 11 versions 25H2 and 24H2, targeting a critical installation failure that affected users following the May 2026 Patch Tuesday release. The update brings OS builds to 26200.8524 and 26100.8524, respectively, resolving a widely reported error that prevented many systems from completing the monthly security […] The post…
